 BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE N. UNNI KRISHNAN NAIR  ORDER Date : 05.01.2026 Mr. H. K. Sarma, learned counsel for the petitioners on instructions submits that the petitioners are not desirous to continue with the matter any further.

Prayer is not objected to by the learned counsel for the respondents.
Accordingly, writ petition stands dismissed on withdrawal.
Interim order, passed earlier, if any, shall stands vacated.
